newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Electric higher after rating upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Electric higher after rating upgrade.

text.p: Share prices of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on early Wednesday morning after Nikko Research Center Ltd upgraded the company to a "1" from its previous "2", brokers said.
By 0025 GMT, Matsushita was up 30 yen to 1,890. Turnover was about 1.3 million shares.
Nikko Research upgraded Matsushita to a "1" from its previous "2", Nikko brokers said earlier on Wednesday.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.

Matsushita announced on Tuesday that it had raised its forecast for group pretax profit in the year to March 31, 1997, to 300 billion yen from its previous outlook of 280.00 billion yen, against its actual 1995/96 pretax profit of 76.62 billion yen.
It also said that it now saw a 1996/97 group net profit of 120 billion yen against its previous net profit forecast of 115 billion yen and an actual net loss of 56.87 billion yen.
Matsushita also said on Tuesday it would write off 100 billion yen in long-term loans to its troubled wholly owned finance unit, NL Finance Co.
